pages.text: Simple pipes provide wired logistics. Item, fluid, and energy pipes connect only to pipes of the same type, and connected pipes form one line. Pipes have no screen, run continuously, and automatically connect to usable adjacent machines or containers.

When placed normally, the container on the clicked side defaults to insert mode. Sneak-place to make that side extract instead. By default, each extracting item pipe moves up to 64 items per tick and uses only one source slot and one target slot per transfer; fluid pipes move 10,000 mB/t and energy pipes move 100,000 FE/t.
Item pipes use an orange identification stripe and craft in batches of 8.
Fluid pipes use a deep-blue identification stripe and craft in batches of 8.
Energy pipes use a red identification stripe and craft in batches of 8.
Right-click a pipe connection with the Sky Wrench to disconnect or reconnect that side. Sneak-right-click a pipe to use the common dismantle behavior and return its drops to your inventory.
Right-click a machine-facing endpoint with the Sky Configurator to switch it between extract and insert without opening the configurator screen. Extract endpoints use a wider collar.

A simple pipe line contains at most 256 pipe blocks by default. If placing or reconnecting a pipe would exceed the limit, the new edge stays disconnected and the player is notified. Different pipe types never join the same line. Transfer rates and the line limit are server-configurable.
